overall_reason: This is the reference demo of a human-built design system (Ant Design Pro), dense and internally consistent, with Chinese-market conventions (red-up/green-down, ¥, 周同比/日同比) that a generic agent would not choose; its weakness is that every value is placeholder, which is acceptable for a template demo but would be slop in a shipped product.

findings.where: store ranking list and search table, tiles 00-01
findings.evidence: Placeholder residue: ranking rows '工专路 0 号店' to '工专路 6 号店' all show the same '323,234'; search keywords are '搜索关键词-0' to '搜索关键词-4'; donut shows '其他: 1,231' and '母婴产品: 1,231'; 'Stores 0' to 'Stores 5' tabs. (Sweep counted the repeated 323,234; the indexed names and 'Stores N' are added here.)
findings.after: For a demo, realistic distinct sample data with a visible 'Sample data' tag; in any real use, [DATA NEEDED: store names and figures]
findings.why: Indexed placeholder names and identical values tell the reader nothing; anyone cloning this template ships them.

findings.where: KPI card sparkline '访问量' and '运营活动效果' progress bar
findings.evidence: The visits sparkline is a purple-to-transparent area fill (#975FE4-ish) unlike the blue system palette elsewhere, and the 78% progress bar runs a blue-to-green gradient (#108ee9 → #87d068). T-DELETION: the gradient adds no data.
findings.before: Purple area sparkline; blue→green gradient bar
findings.after: Use the system blue flat for both; reserve green/red for the change indicators
findings.why: Two decorative colour moves outside the system palette in an otherwise disciplined dashboard.

findings.evidence: Four equal cards each repeat their title twice: '总销售额' in the card head and again as the label above '¥ 126,560' (same for 访问量, 支付笔数, 运营活动效果).
findings.before: Card head '访问量' + label '访问量'
findings.after: Drop the card head or the inner label; keep the info icon with the inner label
findings.why: Doubled labels are kit chrome, not information (CPY-006 pattern).

strengths: Locale-specific conventions are deliberate: red ▲ for increase and green ▼ for decrease, ¥ currency, 周同比/日同比 comparisons.
Information density suits an analyst dashboard: KPI row, sales bar chart with store ranking, search table with sortable columns, category donut, per-store conversion with a brushable time series.
Consistent component system (radii, spacing, table and tab styles) that is clearly authored, not assembled.
not_investigated: Interaction states (date range picker, tab switches, brush) not exercised
Whether the placeholder data is intended: judged as a template demo, which is what the page is
